title: Cookies
intro: This website doesn't use advertising or tracking cookies.
body:
_Last updated: November 2026_

## What we use

We don't use cookies to track you, to show you adverts or to measure how you use the website.

This website doesn't set any cookies of its own, so there's nothing to accept or decline.

## Other websites

When you follow a link to Amazon or another shop, that website's own cookie policy applies.
